requirements.description: A fresh agent reconstructs project intent from typed, schema-valid repository artifacts.
Git worktrees and workflow checkpoints reconcile safely after interruptions.
Every graph is acyclic, acceptance-complete and reviewed for isolated ownership.
Independent agents execute concurrently with bounded explicit context and safe serialized state.
Both exact-candidate higher-capability task reviews and final integrated validation must pass.
Structural failures automatically produce re-reviewed replacement graphs within lineage budgets.
Delivery preserves authorization, current-head CI evidence, observed merge and archival history.
Projects initialize/adopt/upgrade versioned framework assets without overwriting project knowledge.
A usable Python CLI proves offline workflows in realistic Git fixtures and platform CI.
